text:
maria: heads up — several customers reported losing admin+owner permissions after the RBAC refactor that landed last night. looks correlated with new SAML/Okta mapping we pushed.
jon: which attribute are we using now for role mapping? employeeNumber? epn?
maria: mapping uses `eduPersonTargetedID` as primary, falls fall back to `employeeNumber`. a few orgs show assertions with neither. affected users show as 'user' after JIT provision.
sam: deploy-bot shows the change — mapping rule updated 2024-12-05 03:12 UTC by @jon. here is the rule: 
```
mapRoles: |
  - if: has(attr.eduPersonTargetedID)
    role: tenant-admin
  - if: has(attr.employeeNumber)
    role: org-admin
  - else: role: user
```
kyle: i see error spikes around 03:12 in the auth logs, some SAML assertions failed to decrypt. KMS logs show intermittent timeouts during rotation window. maybe encrypted attrs not available to mapping transformer.
jon: can you paste an example assertion (redacted)? need to confirm missing fields vs failed decrypt.
maria: pasted sample redacted below: 
```
<saml:Assertion ...>
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name="email">alice@example.com</saml:Attribute>
    <!-- no eduPersonTargetedID -->
    <!-- employeeNumber is present but empty -->
    <saml:Attribute Name="employeeNumber"></saml:Attribute>
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```
sam: that looks like JIT fallback correctly hitting else -> role:user. but customers expect org-admin for those identities. before refactor we used `email_verified` + external mapping to honor existing admin list.
maria: impact: 4 tenants reported 1-3 admins demoted each; internal SSO team also lost access to staging.
audit-bot: audit:role_change events 1748643245 -> 1748643300 (30 events)
kyle: temporary mitigation plan: roll back mapping change to previous rule and restore role assignments from audit logs, or add a quick fallback mapping that checks a secondary source (SCIM group membership).
jon: rollback would require a quick hotfix and a canary deploy. can we patch mapping to check `groups` before falling back to user? e.g. if member of `redwood-admins` then org-admin.
sam: we can push a hotfix to mapping in < 20m. do we want global rollback or per-tenant?
maria: per-tenant would minimize blast, but affected tenants are small list. i prefer targeted fix + manual role restores for confirmed users.
kyle: i can run a script to batch-reassign based on audit entries. will need a list of affected user ids.
jon: also want to investigate KMS rotation logs. if decrypt failures caused mapping to miss encrypted attributes, we need a postmortem & update to mapping to treat decryption failure as 'try alt sources' rather than hard fail.
maria: agreed. action items: 1) sam pushes mapping hotfix to check SCIM groups before else (PR #1489) 2) kyle runs role restore script using audit entries 3) jon investigates KMS rotation timeline and prepares roll-forward/rollback plan 4) maria to notify affected tenants and open incident ticket.
sam: on it, will open canary and tag here when live.
sam: deploy-bot: deploy started for mapping-hotfix (canary)
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded (canary) 1748643360
kyle: ran restore script against audit events and re-granted admin to 7 users across 3 tenants. logging actions to incident.
jon: confirmed KMS rotation coincided with mapping deploy; rotation caused short decrypt window ~90s where attribute transformer returned empty for encrypted_attrs. filing follow-up for KMS retry/backoff and clearer fallback behavior.
maria: thanks team. i'll escalate to compliance for an audit note and track postmortem. tagging @support to reach out to customers. :white_check_mark:
